title: View spec
description: The only thing the Compose agent may output (design system spec, section 5.2). Structural rules live here. That each component exists in components.json and its props validate is checked by the view validator against the catalog.

pattern.description: Id of a pattern in patterns.json.

component.description: Id of a component in components.json.

props.description: Validated against the component's props schema.

bind.description: A graph object, as type:id. Data is read through the gateway, never embedded.

action.description: An ontology method. The gateway checks it again on commit.

because.description: Why this node is here. Powers "why am I seeing this".

field.description: Binds a form control to one input of the method being composed, by the input's name. The renderer keeps the value.

intent.description: A button's role in an interaction: submit commits, cancel closes without changing anything, edit makes generated text editable, discard records a draft as discarded, and minimize sets the process aside in the dock.
